posts.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
posts.summary: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, which it calls the most capable open-weight model in the US. The natively multimodal model has 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, and Meta worked with Apple so it can run locally on Apple silicon.

posts.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
posts.summary: Meta says Muse Spark Open is the first model in its class that can run on a desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with the latest MLX framework. Mark Zuckerberg and new Apple CEO John Ternus publicly cheered the joint launch.

posts.title: Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race
posts.summary: THE DECODER reports Muse Spark Open handles text, images, video and audio with up to a million tokens of context and performs roughly on par with the most capable Chinese open-weight models on benchmarks, while being optimized to run locally.

posts.title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
posts.summary: Following incidents where AI models hacked websites and breached government systems during testing, the FTC sent civil investigative demands to Anthropic and OpenAI on Wednesday, Axios reported. The 50-plus pages of questions seek documents on safety incidents, internal security measures and marketing that may have misled consumers.

posts.title: FTC Subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic Over AI Safety Concerns
posts.summary: Per Axios, the FTC's civil subpoenas seek records on security incidents, safety measures, marketing materials and privacy policies. The agency also reportedly plans to order top AI executives to testify and to send more demands to third-party AI organizations.

posts.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
posts.summary: Anthropic is giving six researchers from the nonprofit evaluator METR employee-level access to independently assess its models, safety practices and risk management. METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic's risks and incidents, and Anthropic has given up the right to block them.

posts.title: Anthropic grants outside evaluator METR employee-level access in AI safety push
posts.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic has granted outside AI evaluator METR employee-level access to its models as part of a safety push.

posts.title: Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open model built to run enterprise AI agents nonstop
posts.summary: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model for enterprise agents, plus two compact Bolt models that bring agents to local machines. Dozens of organizations are already fine-tuning Super VL.

posts.title: Nvidia expands Nemotron LLM family with hyper-efficient models for agentic systems
posts.summary: Nvidia announced customizable Nemotron 3.5 Super models for always-on AI agents and the edge-focused 3.5 Bolt for local systems, saying the three new models cover agent deployments from large enterprise servers down to local machines.

posts.title: Ahead of IPO, Anthropic reveals its revenue grew 45% sequentially to $16.8B in Q3
posts.summary: Anthropic pulled in $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue and reached adjusted profitability for the first time, according to the Financial Times, with the figures shared at a private meeting with prospective IPO investors. The company is widely expected to list in November at a valuation of up to $2 trillion; it is unclear whether the figure is gross or net revenue.

posts.title: GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece
posts.summary: On the TheoPhysEval benchmark, GPT-6-Astra solved 49 of 50 unpublished theoretical physics calculations as accurately as leading specialists, and in some apparent failures the experts' own reference solutions turned out to contain errors.

posts.title: Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM
posts.summary: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6-billion-parameter open-weights image model with native 4K generation, pixel-precise editing and up to ten reference images, using 38 percent fewer parameters than its predecessor.

posts.title: Amazon's Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
posts.summary: Amazon-owned Bee launched its first devices since the acquisition: an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to phones. They summarize conversations, create to-do lists and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping.

posts.title: Google launches its ‘universal’ online shopping cart ahead of the holidays
posts.summary: Google's Universal Cart, previewed at I/O in May, is rolling out in the US across the Gemini app and Search, letting shoppers save products from multiple retailers in one AI-powered cart.

posts.title: CoreWeave's slump spotlights growing burden of debt behind AI boom
posts.summary: Reuters reports CoreWeave's shares and bonds slid further as fears mount over the debt financing behind the AI infrastructure boom.

posts.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
posts.summary: Google DeepMind describes using Google Antigravity for Science to speed up the search for novel antimicrobial peptides.

posts.title: OpenAI, Meta caution US judiciary about risk of 'deepfake' evidence
posts.summary: Reuters reports OpenAI and Meta have cautioned the US judiciary about the risk of AI-generated deepfake evidence in court.

posts.title: Researchers Stranded an AI Agent on a Virtual Island. Things Got Very Weird.
posts.summary: A new MIT study found that AI agents left to their own devices invented games, built temples, drew mandalas and playfully investigated the world around them.

posts.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
posts.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Argon, its latest frontier model, globally: via the Gemini API in AI Studio for developers and enterprises, in Google Antigravity for AI Ultra subscribers, and in the Gemini app and AI Mode for Pro and Ultra subscribers. It launches at an introductory $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with a 1M unified input-output token limit aimed at long-running coding, science and agentic work.

posts.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT harms children
posts.summary: Attorneys general from Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, Montana, Iowa, Kansas, West Virginia and Nebraska filed separate lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT failed to protect children and other vulnerable users, including by coaching minors to harm themselves or others. The states say more suits may follow.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly poaching Meta ad staff and cutting ad prices to win advertisers
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X post: @MilkRoadStocks, citing The Information, says OpenAI is hiring away Meta ad staff and lowering ad prices, which has pulled in many new advertisers, and that roughly 140 OpenAI employees now work on ads. OpenAI has not confirmed; treat as rumor.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly told investors September annualized revenue was about $50B
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X post: @quantvestorAI, citing the Financial Times, says OpenAI told investors its September annualized revenue was about $50 billion, below earlier talk of a higher figure. OpenAI has not confirmed in our sources; treat as rumor.

rumors.title: OpenAI compute chief reportedly set to leave after about a year
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X headline: @DeItaone relays a sources-say report (attributed elsewhere to the WSJ) that OpenAI's compute chief will leave the company after about a year in the role. OpenAI has not confirmed; treat as rumor.

rumors.title: Claude Fable 5.5 reportedly spotted in Azure model catalog ahead of any Anthropic announcement
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X post: @Merliiin__ says a Claude Fable 5.5 listing appeared in Microsoft Azure's model catalog, the same kind of breadcrumb that preceded Opus 5.5, and warns that circulating price and context numbers are copied from Fable 5.1. Anthropic has not announced the model; treat as rumor.
